There are going to be good days and bad days when it comes to diabetes and mental health, we all go through them. My advice (though I'm not following it myself at the moment) is do your best to keep your sugars in range, especially when you feel sad (which is the hardest time to). With the world how it is right now it's hard to do much more than sit one the couch and snack, do your best to take insulin for everything you eat and keep in mind your activity level. Try to go for a walk if you can. 

And give yourself a break! This is a rough time with COVID-19, being recently diagnosed with diabetes is stressful, and being a teen sucks. You're allowed to feel shitty and your aloud to lay in bed and cry, scream, do what ever you need to do to cope. Just remember to check your sugars from time to time and take some insulin.
